case_number: 2023 INSC 624; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4492 OF 2023 (Arising out of SLP (Civil) No.138 of 2023)
summary: Workmen's Compensation Act disability assessment; total vs partial disablement; standard: incapacity for prior employment (loading/unloading); medical evidence showed left hand uselessness; High Court improperly reduced disability from 50% to 40% ignoring 'unfit for labour' certification; Commissioner's total disablement finding restored; Section 4(1)(b) compensation calculation upheld; intra-court appeal limits respected.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Commissioner's order restored with 100% disablement compensation of Rs.3,74,364/-.
